title: **Israeli Explosions Cause Ground Tremors in Southern Lebanon**
text:
**Israeli Explosions Cause Ground Tremors in Southern Lebanon**"

"🔸 Yisrael Katz, Israel’s defense minister, announced that the Israeli military had destroyed tunnels belonging to Hezbollah in the Ali al-Taher Heights area in southern Lebanon, describing the operation as the result of a complex ground maneuver."

"🔸 According to Israeli media reports, the Israeli military used more than 1,100 tons of explosives to destroy the tunnels. The total length of the tunnels exceeded two kilometers. The reports noted that the network included eight underground routes with a combined length of 5.4 kilometers."

"🔸 Lebanon’s National Geophysical Center confirmed that the massive explosion generated seismic waves comparable to an earthquake, with the intensity of the tremors and their destructive effects equivalent to magnitude 4.2 on the Richter scale."

"▪️ The Ali al-Taher Heights, located in the eastern outskirts of the Nabatieh district in southern Lebanon, are considered a strategically important point in the clashes between the Israeli military and Hezbollah.
